note: Exporter role is confirmed by actual customs records, not by claims: 5 rendered export rows (counter says 48 total) of glazed vitrified tiles, HS 69072100, all shipped from Mundra to Durres, Albania, between 2025-01-21 and 2025-03-06, each with a bill-of-lading number. Declared HS 690721 matches the observed 8-digit code 69072100 — no HS correction needed. Buyer field is "TO THE ORDER" (order/negotiable B/L), so the actual consignee is not public; the only named counterparty in the free view is a freight forwarder (PAYAB BAR INT.TRANSPORT CO., Iran/Bandar Abbas), which is a logistics party, not a buyer. Registered address in the record: "SHOP NO. 322, THIRD FLOOR, SURVEY NCENAL ROAD, KOHINOOR HALL, RAVAPARA" — a shop/office address, consistent with a trading/merchant-exporter profile rather than a factory; role should be treated as trader/merchant exporter (manufacturer status not evidenced). A second slug variant (hidalco-overseas-morbi) returned zero records, so no additional shipments were found there. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey free view shows shipment counts only, no values or quantities, and no annual report or GST data is public. Domestic (India) supply: no traces found in accessible sources; this is a gap in public data, not proof of absence.
